answers.description: Binary error-free segment classification combining two LLM judges: Gemini 3.5 Flash (closed-weight) and Gemma 12B (open-weight, locally served via vLLM), both prompted with the same reference-free error-span prompt (Wmt26SpanTaskV2Directive). A segment is classified error-free only if both judges independently agree (unweighted intersection voting on judge-detected spans).
